clips.title: The story
paras: Viktori Prism'Antras needs one final piece for his telescope in Darkshire. Its frame is built, but no local glass is large enough for the lens his plans require.

Viktori Prism'Antras is building a telescope in Darkshire from plans by the gnome engineer Cog Glitzspinner. He has gathered brass tubes and sturdy mountings from local supplies, but the design calls for an unusually large focusing lens. Magnifying glasses and optical parts from Stormwind traders are too small, so Viktori looks beyond ordinary materials for the piece he needs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device. Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort. The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.
There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood. If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last! The stargazing device is complete! Thank you, friend. Now I can continue my research...
